inlines.text: 이 페이지는 외교·전쟁·공성·포로 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

소비자 계약(ledger-with-optional-siege-or-escape-performance-contest): Preserve registered war-score channel caps and existing event weights; no d10 conversion. Supply/work and stage policies govern siege; 100 score or progress 1 never directly transfers property or creates casualties. Custody transition requires actual event/authority.

blocks.text:
score-contribution [] battle: supplied signed delta subject to cumulative battle channel [-50,50]; enemy leader +100; primary/second/third designated heir +50/+25/+10; enemy capital +10
score-symmetry [] W_defender = -W_attacker
score-deduplication [] unique(warId,eventId,resultId); duplicate tuple is rejected before mutation
endpoint [] abs(W)=100 => terminal lock; revalidate casus belli; settle exactly one fixed terminal effect or invalidate without victory
reinforcement-admission [] arrived && battleStatus=ongoing => mayJoin; battleStatus=ended => cannotJoin
single-loss-settlement [] settlementKey=warId+sourceResultId+lossIdentity; apply at most once
treaty-stage-separation [] legalEffectReceipt != handoverReceipt; fulfillment requires all indivisible required clauses and their stage receipts
D16-F1 [후보·승인 전] battleAfter=clamp(battleBefore+suppliedBattleDelta,-50,50); effectiveBattleDelta=battleAfter-battleBefore; registered other deltas leader100,designatedHeirs50/25/10,capital10; Wafter=clamp(Wbefore+effectiveDelta,-100,100); opponent=-Wafter; abs(Wafter)==100 locks terminal then revalidates CB/beneficiary
D16-F2 [후보·승인 전] siegeProgressAfter=clamp(progress+siegeWork/requiredWork-repair,0,1); each stage requires independent policy and actual supply/access; reaching1 requests registered stage transition, not automatic casualties or ownership
D16-F3 [후보·승인 전] custodyAfter=registeredTransition(captiveEvent,actualLocation,currentCustodian,authority,requiredConsent); release/escape/transport never inferred from war score alone

inlines.text: D16의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

items.text: casusBelliValid/declarationAuthority — boolean with current revision evidence (predicate)
battleStatus/arrivalAt/battleEndedAt — ongoing|ended and ordered clock coordinates (D18 supplied world-clock coordinate)

inlines.text: 자료 소유자는 [object Object], 유지 계약은 score-contribution·score-symmetry·score-deduplication·endpoint·reinforcement-admission·single-loss-settlement·treaty-stage-separation다. 상태 소유 경계는 war/CB/fixed beneficiary,score W,battle channel,processed tuple,terminal receipt,siege stages/work/supply,actual captive location/custodian. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

items.text: 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_EXTERNAL_ORDER, E_EVENT_CONFLICT
기존 평가기 오류: E_UNIT, E_SCORE, E_FIELDS, E_REPLAY, E_BATTLE_CAP, E_EVENT_KIND, E_ENDPOINT, E_UNKNOWN, E_HELD_INPUT, E_CUSTODY_POLICY_HELD

어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

inlines.text: 현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D16-war-score-siege-custody(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/war-score-siege-custody.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/war-score-siege-custody.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.
